# Covert Coder

> Local-first engineering workbench. Vibe at the surface. Engineering underneath.

- Status: pre-production; source presence is not production readiness.
- Frontend: typed DOM cockpit, Monaco editor, real governed PTY.
- Launch: npm ci, npm run doctor, npm start; browser at http://127.0.0.1:4173/.
- Pair using the one-use code issued by typing pair in the launch terminal.
- Resident is advisory and has data-authority="none"; exact operations remain governed.
- Models distinguish artifact presence, startability, running state, and verified route readiness.
- Veritas owns verification; historical passes do not verify current work.
- Memory, Skill Intelligence, providers and extensions have explicit partial/experimental boundaries.
- Harness Modes: one canonical Harness with domain-specific composition; dynamic mode loading remains planned.
- Online providers and downloads are explicit network choices.
